intro.h2: Cabinets and stone under one roof
paragraphs: Elizabeth Kitchen & Granite handles kitchen remodeling in Elizabeth with both halves of the job in its own hands: the cabinets and the countertops. The team says it has been in this business for over 15 years, fabricating granite, quartz, marble and quartzite.

Customers keep pointing to the same things. Juan and the staff make sure measurements are correct, the office keeps you updated, the fabricator is skilled and the install team does a clean job. One reviewer wrote that Juan worked with the supplier to sort out a quartz issue on their order. Others say prices are affordable and that the team treats you like family when you have hard decisions to make.

about.text: Elizabeth Kitchen & Granite LLC is a Latino-owned kitchen remodeler at 719 Livingston St in Elizabeth, New Jersey. On its Facebook page the company says it has been in this business for over 15 years as a fabricator of stones such as granite, quartz, marble and quartzite. The showroom is packed with full cabinet displays, a farmhouse sink set in quartz and racks of stone samples. Juan is the name customers mention most, alongside an office team that keeps people updated, a skilled fabricator and an installation crew. The showroom is open Monday through Saturday.

image.alt: Inside the Elizabeth Kitchen & Granite showroom on Livingston St, Elizabeth, NJ

steps.title: Visit the showroom
steps.text: Stop by 719 Livingston St Monday to Saturday, 9 AM to 5 PM, or call to talk about your kitchen.

steps.title: Measure and design
steps.text: The team takes measurements and makes sure they are correct, then helps you choose cabinets, layout and stone.

steps.title: Order and fabricate
steps.text: Cabinets are ordered and the fabricator cuts your granite, quartz, marble or quartzite tops. The office keeps you updated.

steps.title: Install
steps.text: The installation team sets cabinets and countertops. If a supplier issue comes up, the team works to resolve it with you.

items.name: M. D.
items.text: We had a great experience with Elizabeth Kitchen and Granite. Juan diligently helped resolve a quartz issue with the supplier, the office kept me updated, the fabricator was very skilled, and the installation team did a great job. The price was good and the process took a little longer than expected; however, most of it was out of the hands of the company.

items.name: Elaine M.
items.text: Elizabeth Kitchen and Granite are by far one of the best experience in a stressful situation when you have hard decisions to make. They are very reasonable on cabinets and make sure that measurements are correct. Juan and staff are amazing! Thank you.

items.name: Holley P.
items.text: This was an amazing experience from beginning to end. Everyone was warm and friendly, and their prices are affordable. They literally treat you like family, ensuring that you feel welcomed and valued throughout the entire process. The exceptional service and genuine care provided by the staff made the experience truly memorable. Please visit 10 stars….HP

service_area.text: Elizabeth Kitchen & Granite works from its showroom and shop at 719 Livingston St, Elizabeth, NJ 07201. Homeowners from Elizabeth come in to choose cabinets and stone, and the team measures and installs in their homes. If you live outside Elizabeth and want to know whether the team can measure and install at your address, call (908) 662-9512 Monday to Saturday.

items.q: What countertop materials do you offer?
items.a: Elizabeth Kitchen & Granite fabricates granite, quartz, marble and quartzite. The showroom has racks of stone samples and display tops, including a farmhouse sink set in quartz, so you can see colours and edges in person before you choose the stone for your kitchen.

Yes. The showroom displays many cabinet styles and colours, from white and cream raised panel to grey wood-grain shaker, espresso, navy and cherry red. Reviewers say the company is very reasonable on cabinets and makes sure measurements are correct before ordering.

The showroom at 719 Livingston St is open Monday through Saturday from 9 AM to 5 PM and closed on Sunday. You can call (908) 662-9512 during those hours or email elizabethgranite1@gmail.com with photos and rough measurements of your kitchen at any time.

items.q: How long have you been in business?
items.a: The company says on its Facebook page that it has been in this business for over 15 years, working as a fabricator of granite, quartz, marble and quartzite. It now holds a 4.8 star rating from 19 reviews on Google, with Juan and the staff named often.

items.q: How do I start my kitchen project?
items.a: Call (908) 662-9512 or visit the showroom to talk through your kitchen. The team will take measurements, help you choose cabinets and stone, and give you a price. Reviewers say the office keeps you updated all the way through fabrication and installation.

final_cta.h2: Ready to plan your new kitchen?
final_cta.text: Visit the Livingston St showroom or give Juan and the team a call.
